cited_checks.note: The supplied attested Appendix Theorem 3 specializes with d=T and r=2 to a T-2-column anchor-triple submatrix whose every subcollection has support size at least its cardinality plus 2; this is exactly the cited node's generic coordinate-projection criterion.

The supplied attested Lei--Ross Theorem 1 states that rank-two general-position factors and O3 convergence to one all-outcome super-cohort give Gamma's column space as the population APM null space; the node instantiates that conclusion with the core relation operator.

The supplied attested dependence criterion says a relation-column subfamily is dependent exactly when some subfamily has more columns than support coordinates minus r. With r=2 and triple supports, its negation is precisely |F'| <= |V(F')|-2, yielding the stated generic matroid rank.
